purpose.zh: 练大腿和臀部，提升单腿力量
purpose.en: Build the thighs and glutes for single-leg strength.

text.zh: 双脚原地前后分开，身体垂直下沉
text.en: Keep your split stance and lower straight down

text.zh: 前脚整只踩地，前膝对准脚尖
text.en: Keep your whole front foot down and your front knee over your toes.

text.zh: 用前脚推地站起，躯干挺直
text.en: Push through your front foot to rise, keeping your trunk tall.

commonErrors.en: Letting the front knee cave in.

cautions.zh: 从轻重量开始，出现疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Start with a light weight, and stop if you feel pain.

cautions.zh: 膝盖不适时减小下蹲深度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Squat less deep if your knees feel uncomfortable, and stop if the pain continues.
